name: Empire of Japan

flag.description: A white field with a red disc set towards the hoist, from which sixteen red rays spread out to the edges.
flag.symbolism: The red disc is the sun, as on Japan's national flag; the rayed version was the army flag from 1870 and the naval ensign from 1889, while the national flag remained the plain Hinomaru.

hook: The Rising Sun Flag, carried by Japan's armed forces during its wars of conquest in Asia, sends sixteen red rays out from an off-centre sun; Japan's national flag, then and now, is the plain red disc.
trivia: Japan's Maritime Self-Defense Force has used the same sixteen-ray design as its ensign since 1954.
The flag is highly controversial in South Korea and China, where many see it as a symbol of Japanese wartime aggression and colonial rule.
